ChallengeEnd.description: Rules 0.8.1: a duel over, applied at the resolve (`round.outcome.public.duels[]`).

deed.description: One line: the duel mind's, else the rules'.

log.description: The blows this final resolve was handed (earlier ones came live and in challenge.open).

panels.description: Rules 0.8.2: the rest of its panels, through the outro (`starts_at_ms` may lie ahead: play them out).

pos.description: `at` at full precision (outcome numbers are rounded to 2 decimals except `pos`).

provisional.description: State schema 12, live only: shown at once by the duel action that closed the duel (a knockout's outro, or the first action stamped past the deadline): who won and the healths, `deed` empty, `log` empty. The next resolve applies it and sends the full `challenge.end` for the same `duel_id`.

ChallengeLock.description: Rules 0.8.1: `phase.event.public` when a challenge is accepted (or `round.started.public.challenges[]` for the AI's): both portraits lock in.

a.description: Rules 0.8.1: one duellist at the lock.

health.description: Health at the lock (both are shown: the duel's health bars).

skin.description: Its mannequin's skin. From the name: FNV-1a 32 of the name's UTF-8 bytes with ASCII A-Z lower-cased, mod 5 in this order; unless it holds a thing a god granted (dragonscale) or a thing of gold (gold). Absent from servers before this field: compute it from the name.

also.description: Rules 0.8.2: the duel's scene and panel 0, made with the lock (state schema 12: then the first typing script of each AI fighter). Handle each entry as its own event.

b.description: Rules 0.8.1: one duellist at the lock.

health.description: Health at the lock (both are shown: the duel's health bars).

skin.description: Its mannequin's skin. From the name: FNV-1a 32 of the name's UTF-8 bytes with ASCII A-Z lower-cased, mod 5 in this order; unless it holds a thing a god granted (dragonscale) or a thing of gold (gold). Absent from servers before this field: compute it from the name.

by_seat.description: The challenger's seat; null for the AI.

deadline_ms.description: Epoch ms: lines after it are refused (null for the AI's challenges).

duel_id.description: duel:s<seq>:<a>:<b> (a player's challenge: its action's seq) or duel:<beat>:<a>:<b> (the AI's)

ends_beat.description: The last beat whose resolve may still carry it (the world keeps beating meanwhile).

focus.description: Centre the camera and spin the globe here.

freeze.description: The world hold the duel requests (supported once the engine has holds).

leap.description: The AI challenger summoned itself next to its rival first (applied at the resolve).

world.description: beating until the engine offers a hold window.

DuelBlow.description: Rules 0.8.1: `phase.event.public` for each duel line, at once (also in the resolve's challenge.open / challenge.end log).

ai.description: State schema 12: an AI fighter's typed line (its typing script's text), entered at `at_ms` = the script's `ends_at_ms`. It has no `seq`.

also.description: Live event only: what this line's stamp made due: panels (rules 0.8.2), and in state schema 12 the AI lines entered before it (`duel.blow`, `ai: true`), the typing scripts of the windows opened, and a provisional `challenge.end` when it closed the duel. Handle each as its own event.

anim.description: Rules 0.8.1: animation cues for the figures (deterministic, from the rules).

auto.description: An automatic blow (an AI counter or a duel nobody typed in).

choreo.description: Rules 0.8.1: the formal model's choreography of one strike (DM_RULEBOOK 21.4).

contacts.description: Every contact: who hits, with which limb, which body part of the other, when (empty when nothing lands).

handicap.description: State schema 12: an AI's typed line against a human (minus `duel_ai_handicap`).

move.description: State schema 12: what the line's words picked (docs/CLIENT_API.md "Words to moves"): the clip its figure plays for this strike.

object.description: State schema 14: the scene object the pick's path uses.

path.description: `leap`: the figure leaves the ground. State schema 14: a pick may also send it `vault` / `slide` / `wallkick` over, under or off `object`.

picker.description: State schema 14: the LLM picker staged it (`pre`: known at the line's arrival, it also chose the class; `used`: came before the panel's input close; `class`: its clip did not serve the class the rules resolved, `weapon`: its clip belongs to a weapon the fighter does not wield; in both only `target` was taken). Absent: the mapper's.

setup.description: The clips of the earlier move words of the line, played first (at most two).

steps.description: State schema 21: the line staged as up to 4 steps (the panel plays them in order; the d20 and the matrix still decide the blow). Present when the line has more than one step or one that moves or uses a thing.

target.description: State schema 14: the body part the pick aimed at (state schema 21: or the line's words; `neck` for a throat).

throw.description: State schema 21: what the line throws (it flies as a projectile with `thing`).

uses.description: State schema 21: what the line uses of what its fighter can use.

weapon_class.description: State schema 14: what it fights with for this strike.

whiff.description: State schema 21: the line named a thing that is not there (not held, not on the board, not this ground): the blow fails, `unavailable` costs 2 wit.

word.description: The move word read (as the table has it: `attack` for `attck`); null: none, the class's own clip.

self_damage.description: A penalty's cost to its author.

stage.description: State schema 21: what to play AT ONCE on Enter (the keyword fallback, no model, no panel wait): the line's steps, or its move as one step; a whiff is one `stagger_waist` step with `whiff: true`. The panel may refine it later.

tags.description: What the wit saw: verb, combo, body, item, terrain, story, repeat, echo, short, spam, empty, rate_limit.

window.description: State schema 12 (with `ai`): the panel whose input window the line was typed in.

DuelDraw.description: State schema 14: a line that pulled something out (`duel.blow.move.draw`): a held item (free) or hammer-space (the item engine's odds as a d20 target, sparks).

held.description: A held item: drawn for free.

need.description: What it had to reach (a 20 always works, a 1 never).

p.description: The item engine's success probability for it.

sparks.description: Sparks it cost (paid at the resolve).

verdict.description: `drawn`: a held item; `success`: the prop is in hand for the rest of the duel; `fumble`: the initiative flipped to the foe before the blow; `spent`: no draws left (`duel_draws`), the line is read without it.

DuelFighterLook.description: State schema 21: how a fighter looks, to dress the mannequin as its main character: the demigod's `look` (loadout, loadout_hash, ...; images on: `portrait_image`, `diorama_image`), `aura` (#rrggbb), `held` [{ref, name, kind, weapon_class, material, colour, colour_hex, icon, art?, image?}], `figure_key` (the assets registry's subject key) and `statue` (null from the plugin: look it up at GET /api/assets/figures?name=).

DuelPanel.description: Rules 0.8.2: `duel.panel`, one comic panel of a duel: the presentation of the blows of one input window (they are decided by the 0.8.1 rules; a panel decides nothing). Sent in `also[]` of the action that made it due, as the event of a `duel_tick`, in `challenge.open` / `challenge.end`, and all of them in `present.duels[].panels`.

at.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

auto.description: An automatic counter of its is staged here.

default.description: It did nothing in the window: the rules default it plays.

line.description: The last line it typed in the window this panel stages (null: none).

line_masked_len.description: That line's length in characters (0: none).

lines.description: Lines it typed in the window.

move_class.description: Its last move's class (strike, heavy, guard, parry, feint, evade, close, retreat, grapple, throw, invoke, command, taunt).

segs.description: Clip segments in order; their `ms` sum to `play_ms`.

at.description: State schema 14: start this many ms into the clip (its trim), played at `speed`.

on.description: wallrun, wallkick, mantle: the object id.

to.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

weapon_class.description: State schema 14: what it has in hand at the panel's end.

also.description: Live event only: further panels made due by the same action (state schema 12: also the AI lines it entered, the typing scripts of the windows opened, and a provisional `challenge.end` after the outro).

blows.description: The `n` of each duel.blow it stages.

at.description: On a fighter: where (`neck`: state schema 21).

on.description: `a` / `b` (the fighter hit) or a scene object's id.

input_closes_ms.description: starts_at_ms + play_ms - 700 (the render lead); null: no input (a knockout, the last slot, the outro). Lines stamped up to it feed panel n + 1.

ko.description: Outro only: the side knocked out.

play_ms.description: 2400..3600; in state schema 12, a panel that opens a window an AI types in plays as long as its line needs (up to about 6000).

projectiles.description: State schema 14: what flies in this panel (ranged weapons, invokes).

sim.description: State schema 14, live stream only (never in challenge.open / challenge.end): the duel sim's baked physics for this panel (docs/DUEL_SIM.md).

starts_at_ms.description: Server epoch ms: the previous panel's end.

DuelProjectile.description: State schema 14: one thing that flies in a panel (`duel.panel.projectiles[]`), decided by its blow's verdict and seeded. The duel sim reads `t_fire_ms`, `t_hit_ms`, `to`, `speed`, `on_hit.impulse`, `on_hit.aoe_hexes`, `on_hit.objects`: these names are stable.

arc_h.description: Apex above the straight line, m.

deflected_by.description: `a` / `b`: a parry or a shield turned it aside.

aoe_hexes.description: A rocket: the landing hex and its six neighbours.

objects.description: A rocket: the scene objects in the blast.

t_hit_ms.description: Lands (the blow's contact is at this time, `ranged: true`).

thing.description: State schema 21: what was thrown (the blow's `move.throw`: a board object, a handful of ground, a held thing).

to.description: `a` / `b` (a hit), a scene object's id (a miss that lands on it), or a hex [q, r].

DuelProp.description: State schema 14: the weapon in a fighter's hand (on `duel.blow.move.prop` and on panel segs): what the client puts in the hand.

colour.description: State schema 21: the colour its name gives (obsidian: black, golden: gold, ...).

item.description: The world item's ref (`it:N`); null: a hammer-space prop (it exists only in the duel).

kind.description: The item kind (weapon, armor, relic, artifact).

DuelScene.description: Rules 0.8.2: `duel.scene`, the duel's stage dressing in the duel lab's scene shape (in the lock's `also[]`, and in `present.duels[].scene`). `source: rules` is the deterministic fallback; an authored scene will use the same shape.

a_start.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

b_start.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

biome.description: harbour | forest | desert | hills | town | wild

clip_fallbacks.description: State schema 14: what a client without a clip plays instead (from the list).

fighters.description: State schema 21: each fighter's look and what it can use.

list_version.description: State schema 14: the duel move list the duel is read with (data/duel_moves.json's version).

affords.description: The paths that may name it.

note.description: One line (a cairn's: what the DM remembers here).

offset.description: The part's centre from the object's origin on the floor.

size.description: box [w,h,d]; cylinder, cone [r,h]; the others [r]. Metres.

sim.description: State schema 14, live stream and present only: the duel sim's stage (masses, affordances, fighters; docs/DUEL_SIM.md).

DuelSceneFighter.description: State schema 21: one fighter on the scene.

ground.description: The ground the step picks up.

object_id.description: The board object the step uses.

DuelTyping.description: `duel.typing`: a duellist is typing (the relay of its `fields.duel_keys`). Ephemeral: shown once, stored nowhere, never in `present.events`. Mask the line as `len` stars with `tail` as its newest characters.

len.description: Characters in its line now; 0: cleared.

tail.description: The newest characters since its last message (may be empty).

DuelTypingScript.description: State schema 12: `duel.typing_script`, the line an AI fighter types in one input window, to be played back by every client as masked live typing (the server sends no frames). Character k (1-based) appears at `starts_at_ms + k * key_ms + the ms of every pause with after < k`; at `ends_at_ms` it presses Enter and the line is a `duel.blow` (`ai: true`). Sent in `also[]` after the panel that opens the window (and after the lock), on that panel as `a|b.typing_script`, and while it is being typed in `present.duels[].typing_scripts`.

cps.description: Characters a second (seeded per demigod and match).

pauses.description: 0 to 2 pauses between words, in order.

starts_at_ms.description: Server epoch ms: it starts typing (after the window opens).

text.description: The whole line. Public by design: mask it as you mask live typing.

window.description: The panel (`n`) whose input window it is typed in.

DuelUsable.description: State schema 21: what a fighter can use in its duel (the tray's chips): its held items, the board's objects, the hex's ground.

ground.description: What it can pick up off the ground.

art.description: Its item art's key, when it has item art.

FaultJunction.description: State schema 16: the plate-boundary junction pulling on a mega (the strongest pull within fault_junction_km).

kind.description: triple: boundaries of 3+ plates meet; knot: a dense, twisting stretch of boundary far from any triple junction.

km.description: Great-circle distance (km) from the aim to it.

name.description: Its name when it is a famous one ("Afar triple junction"): narration says "at the Afar triple junction".

plates.description: PB2002 plate codes meeting there (sorted); empty for a knot.

strength.description: 0..1: the strongest triple junction is 1 (by the size of the plates meeting and the boundary around it).

FaultTier.description: State schema 16: a mega's tier: junction (within fault_junction_km of a junction), fault (≤ fault_near_km from a fault line), near (the first half of the curve), mild (the second half), tiny (≥ fault_far_km: a tiny volcano; its lasting mods stay local).

LonLat.description: [longitude, latitude] in degrees (WGS84). Note the order: longitude first.

Ref.description: A pointer to any row of the world: dg demigod, ch character, cl cluster, gr group, gd god, pl place, it item, ag agent, lg ledger row, ce cell, mb mob. Stable for the whole match.

bill_now.description: The bill if Enter came now (at opening): one bolt and `debt_base`.

bolt_paid.description: The purse has the bolt (else the debt is doubled, already in debt_base).

by.description: The initiator: the player's name (rules 0.7.0; before, the demigod's).

deadline_ms.description: When it closes at the latest (epoch ms).

debt_base.description: debt(t) = min(debt_cap, debt_base + debt_per_second × t), t = seconds since opened_at_ms.

opened_at_ms.description: Rules 0.7.0, the live Time bill: when the window opened (server epoch ms).

repeat_factor.description: 1 + 0.5 × the opener's slows in the last 20 beats (already in debt_base).

slow_ms.description: How long the window stays open at most.

Streak.description: `phase.event.public` the moment an instant cast is accepted: its streak, for everyone. The first cast's fields are repeated at the top level.

casts.description: Every cast in the action, in order.

items.description: One cast of the streak, as aimed (nothing is paid until the next resolve; at Entropy ≥ 40 it may still land off target).

fault_factor.description: Rules 0.8.0, megas only: the damage multiplier the fault rule gives (1.6 near a fault .. 0.6 far).

fault_km.description: Rules 0.8.0, megas only: great-circle distance (km) from the aim to the nearest fault line.

fizzled.description: Its target doesn't exist (it will fizzle).

junction.description: State schema 16, megas only: the junction it falls near (its multipliers are in fault_factor, radius_km and the magnitude), or null.

place.description: The most specific place aimed at.

target.description: What it is aimed at directly, or null (a point).

fault_factor.description: Rules 0.8.0: first cast, a mega: the fault rule's damage multiplier.

fault_km.description: Rules 0.8.0: first cast, a mega: distance (km) to the nearest fault line.

junction.description: State schema 16, megas only: the junction it falls near (its multipliers are in fault_factor, radius_km and the magnitude), or null.

received_at_ms.description: When the server received it (epoch ms).

seq.description: The action's room-wide arrival order (casts are paid in this order).

Summoning.description: Rules 0.8.0: `phase.event.public` the moment a summoning or a god-tier power is accepted (it lands at the next resolve).

health_lost.description: Rules 0.8.1: health the resolve will take.

roll.description: Rules 0.8.1: the first summoning's mishap d20 (the damage check comes before the teleport).

health_lost.description: Rules 0.8.1: what the resolve will take.

roll.description: Rules 0.8.1: the mishap d20, decided at the accept.

description: `phase.event.public`: an immediate push from the game. `event` says which.
title: phase.event public
